indicators.label: Temples and churches (count)
indicators.description: Administrative count of registered religious organisations (monasteries, temples, churches) in the aimag or Capital, Total type of religion, from NSO statbank table DT_NSO_2003_001V1. indicators.method: Published statbank cell for the region, year, and the Total type of religion; no aggregation, no denominator.

indicators.label: Temples and churches by type of religion
